blocks.text:
Start in Bogotá with the colonial streets of La Candelaria, gold artefacts from pre-Columbian civilisations and the view from Monserrate. The next day, the city’s museums give way to a walk by Lake Guatavita and the underground chambers of the Salt Cathedral.

In the Coffee Region, Cocora’s wax palms rise above a green valley, and at El Ocaso farm you can follow the journey from bean to cup. After ziplining and a horseback ride, continue to Medellín to see the murals of Comuna 13 and the colourful façades of Guatapé. Spend the final 2 nights in Cartagena, with its colonial city, San Felipe fortress and a day by the Caribbean Sea in the Rosario Islands.

## Accommodation and prices

Prices are in USD per person. The programme includes 2 nights in each of the 4 cities.

SGL: single occupancy; DBL: double occupancy; TRP: triple occupancy.

Services are based on English-speaking guides; assistance in another language can be arranged on request. International and domestic flights are charged separately. The applicability of rates and exact travel dates in 2027 are confirmed at the time of booking.
